slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: the calm, organised feeling of a trip handled by an expert before it begins.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with negative space on one side for a title. Overhead or 45 degree still life on natural linen: two passports (covers plain or turned face down), a closed leather itinerary notebook, a fountain pen, two blank kraft or leather luggage tags with plain string, a sprig of olive or soft florals. Soft morning window light, warm neutral palette, no people. No airline, hotel, cruise, card or travel brand logos or branding visible anywhere (luggage, tags, documents, screens, linen). No readable names, passport numbers, booking references, barcodes or personal details. Source: library register, Canva brand asset or licensed stock. AI only if Wedded Wonderland approves, and then labelled 'Illustrative image'. Never competitor images.
